[EN] Grandpa's Stories
[ES] Historias del abuelo
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please bring me the treasures of Baracos. I've spent my entire life dreaming about them!
[ES] ¡Por favor, tráeme los tesoros de Baracos! ¡He pasado toda mi vida soñando con ellos!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] What else is a lie? Do we really even exist?
[ES] ¿Qué otra cosa es una mentira? ¿Realmente existimos?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the dagger.
[ES] Toma la daga.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the bracelet.
[ES] Toma el brazalete.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Examine treasure chests in the Golden Labyrinth. [You must select Golden Labyrinth (Solo) from the {@LinkCreature:208#1501#Teleportal} to advance this quest.]
[ES] Examina los cofres del tesoro en Golden Labyrinth. [Debes seleccionar Golden Labyrinth (Solo) en el {@LinkCreature:208#1501#Teleportal} para avanzar en esta misión.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sorry I couldn't help more."
[ES] "Lamento no haber podido ayudar más."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the recovered goods to Avil.
[ES] Entrega los bienes recuperados a Avil.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
